title: History and Architecture of Echo Park
includes: We provide the guide and information. You arrive ready to learn and have fun!
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Why spend several hours looking at hedges and gates of homes in the Hollywood Hills, when you can get up close to many of LA's most beautiful and historic homes on this walking tour of Echo Park? If you like major movies like Fast and Furious or shows like Charmed, this tour will show you some of the most filmed homes in all of LA! You'll take a trek through one of LA's most stunning parks, with views of Downtown and Dodger Stadium. Fans of movies, architecture, history, nature, baseball, and more will all find something to love along our tour route.
